purpose: Local browser libsodium sealed-box encryption for GitHub Actions repository Secrets API public keys. This is a mobile setup page dependency, not a renderer dependency.
buildRecipe: Fetch each exact metadata URL over verified HTTPS using the configured proxy.
Require exact pinned npmIntegrity shown in this manifest.
Fetch the exact tarball URL and verify its SHA-512 npm integrity and SHA-256.
Read only regular package/dist/modules/<name>.js and package/LICENSE members; reject absolute paths, traversal and symlink extraction.
Copy those bytes unchanged to web/vendor/<name>.js and web/vendor/<name>.LICENSE. No npm install, lifecycle scripts, transpilation, minification or other execution occurs.
runtime: Serve both JS files locally from the same origin. Never load crypto code from a runtime CDN.
Load libsodium.js before libsodium-wrappers.js using classic scripts; wait for window.sodium.ready.
Use sodium.crypto_box_seal(UTF-8 Secret bytes, sodium.from_base64(public_key, sodium.base64_variants.ORIGINAL)); base64 encode result with ORIGINAL variant for GitHub encrypted_value.
A restrictive Content-Security-Policy needs script-src self plus wasm-unsafe-eval for the embedded WebAssembly module; unsafe-eval is not required.
Zero plaintext byte arrays with sodium.memzero when no longer needed; never log the plaintext or encrypted request body.

verification.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; connect-src 'none'; style-src 'none'; img-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
requirements: Node.js with the existing Playwright module resolvable by require()
Existing Chromium (CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE optional; /usr/bin/chromium otherwise Playwright default)
